craft_notes: Sthāyin: urging arrival. Device: semicolon→comma (lodging sued softly), dash→colon (coming released). Rejected: 'bide' for 'lodge' — killed: lodge kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Dreadless, bliss-stuffed, sole, unwasting — lodge that footing with me,
come, god, fleet: why dally for yon?
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirbhayaṃ yad yad ānandamayam ekaṃ yad avyayam padaṃ dehy ehi me deva tūrṇaṃ tat kiṃ pratīkṣase

reads_against.argmap: Fearless, bliss-constituted, one, imperishable — give the state, come to me, O god.; Quickly — why wait for that? → Give the fearless bliss-state quickly; why wait?
